mapper.select: SELECT s.settlement_id, s.application_id, s.item_code, c.code_name AS item_name, s.expense_date, s.vendor_name, s.supply_amount, s.vat_amount, s.total_amount, s.description, s.receipt_file_name, s.status, s.reject_reason, s.created_at FROM settlement s LEFT JOIN com_code_detail c ON s.item_code = c.code_id AND c.group_id = 'EXP_ITEM' WHERE s.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY s.expense_date DESC, s.settlement_id DESC

SELECT s.settlement_id, s.application_id, s.item_code, c.code_name AS item_name, s.expense_date, s.vendor_name, s.supply_amount, s.vat_amount, s.total_amount, s.description, s.receipt_file_name, s.status, s.reject_reason, s.created_at FROM settlement s LEFT JOIN com_code_detail c ON s.item_code = c.code_id AND c.group_id = 'EXP_ITEM' WHERE s.settlement_id = #{settlementId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM settlement WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'APPROVED'
